title: Jack Rabbit Cyber Rabbit Argon E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Argon by Jack Rabbit’s Cyber Rabbit is an irresistible blend of two bold fruit flavours, lemon and blackcurrant. You might expect this juice to be overly sharp, but the flavours have been so expertly blended that the blackcurrant provides a wonderfully soft, deep and dark sweetness that’s perfectly balanced with the bright and zesty lemon. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
